notes.title: Update to ver.01.00.03
notes.content:
Smooth camera movement has been added as a measure against screen sickness.
The character you are controlling will change the direction of its body by hovering in conjunction with the camera movement.

This may appear to be an unnatural movement when looking at the feet, but this is not an anomaly.
